overall_explanation: The reviewed changes correctly add synchronous atomic boundaries to the in-memory and SQLite owners, reject native async callbacks before invocation, preserve thenable rejection, restore rolled-back in-memory state including evictions, and make duplicate invalidation IDs require equal sanitized content in both stores. The added tests cover SQL failure rollback, rejected/skipped writes, reader visibility, SUPERSEDE relation failure, retry, DELETE outcomes, and conflicting invalidation records. No actionable defect was identified within the supplied scope; production persistence remains disabled by default.
